scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run check:guardrails && bun run check:migrations && bun run check:deps && bun run check:secrets && bun run tf:check
scripts.tf:drift: bun scripts/tf.ts global plan -detailed-exitcode && bun scripts/tf.ts prod plan -detailed-exitcode
scripts.smoke:models: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(security find-generic-password -s rhumbatron-anthropic-api-key -w) ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID=$(security find-generic-password -s rhumbatron-anthropic-workspace-id -w) CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$(security find-generic-password -s rhumbatron-cloudflare-account-id -w) bun scripts/smoke-models.ts
scripts.cost:report: CLOUDFLARE_MONITOR_TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -s rhumbatron-cloudflare-monitor-token -w) CLOUDFLARE_D1_TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -s rhumbatron-cloudflare-api-token -w) CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=$(security find-generic-password -s rhumbatron-cloudflare-account-id -w) bun scripts/cost-report.ts
